newsitem.title: SPAIN: Tafisa says Sonae not planning bid -CNMV.
newsitem.headline: Tafisa says Sonae not planning bid -CNMV.

text.p: Tafisa said on Tuesday that it had no information that Sonae Industria was planning to launch a buyout, denying a press report, according to national stocks commission CNMV.

In a letter to the stocks commission, Tafisa said it had agreed a capital increase of 2.88 billion pesetas, with an issue premium of 1,500 pesetas. This along with a 10-year bonds issue for a maximum amount of 5.0 billion pesetas will finance investment.
Sonae Industria has only expressed interest in underwriting the proportion of the issue corresponding to its current stake in Tafisa, that is, 49.97 percent, the letter said.
